item.title: Ohio orders 10 prediction market operators to stop sports contracts after Sixth Circuit win — Oct 17, 2026 · 11:00 AM ET
item.description: - **Ohio orders 10 prediction market operators to stop sports contracts after Sixth Circuit win** — The Ohio Casino Control Commission sent cease-and-desist letters dated October 2 to Coinbase, Gemini Titan, Moomoo Financial, Novig, Plus500US, Polymarket, ProphetX, Robinhood Derivatives, Underdog and Webull Financial, ordering each to stop offering sports event contracts in Ohio and notify the commission in writing within 14 days. The letters rely on the Sixth Circuit September 25 ruling that federal law does not preempt Ohio sports gaming law, and Kalshi was not a recipient because its penalty case is already under way. ([iGaming Times](https://igaming-times.com/news/prediction-markets/ohio-orders-10-prediction-markets-to-stop-sports-contracts-a-week-after-its-sixth-circuit-win))

item.title: Three California tribes launch Kalshi-powered prediction market apps as a fourth tribal partnership is disputed — Oct 17, 2026 · 10:45 AM ET
item.description: - **Three California tribes launch Kalshi-powered prediction market apps as a fourth tribal partnership is disputed** — Three California tribes are launching prediction market apps on Kalshi's exchange: Sovereign Edge from the Kletsel Dehe Wintun Nation, Greenville from Greenville Rancheria, and AIR Markets from Alturas Indian Rancheria, with each tribe owning its brand and customers while Kalshi runs matching and clearing. Kalshi's release listed a fourth app, PokkeTrades from Oklahoma's Alabama-Quassarte Tribal Town, but that tribe's chief has since said no such deal exists. ([Bookmakers Review](https://www.bookmakersreview.com/industry/3-california-tribes-launch-kalshi-powered-prediction-market-apps/))
